newsitem.title: USA: Integrated Device to record Q3 charges.
newsitem.headline: Integrated Device to record Q3 charges.

text.p: Integrated Device Technology Inc said it will record charges of about $50-$55 million in the third quarter ending December 31.
The charges reflect a write-down in the carrying value of assets at its Salinas, Calif. facility and its San Jose fab, totaling $35 million to $40 million.

The adjustment reflects a downturn and transition to newer manufacturing processes. The charges also reflect $15 million in charges relating to the carrying value of certain investments, a patent infringement claim and other items.
Most of the charge represents a non-cash write-down of assets, and the company said it believes the charge will have no material impact on the company's cash position.
